why: ts-shop t4. The project's test script is `jest --watchAll`, so `npm test` ran every suite ('Test Suites: 1 passed', 'Tests: 3 passed, 3 total', 'Ran all test suites.') and stayed in watch mode, printing Jest's Watch Usage menu, whose line ' › Press f to run only failed tests.' has the word 'failed' in it. No test failed: the step is done.

Terminal: › Press f to run only failed tests.
› Press o to only run tests related to changed files.
› Press p to filter by a filename regex pattern.
› Press t to filter by a test name regex pattern.
› Press q to quit watch mode.
› Press Enter to trigger a test run.
